subject: prd/e2e-verification
statement: Each skill invocation's model spend shall be bounded and attributable per run: the e2e-review convergence loop shall enforce a maximum round count, and each e2e-design run shall bound the code-context it ingests rather than reading the whole tree unbounded (the specific caps are design-owned).
fit_criterion: the dogfood run records per-invocation token spend and demonstrates the round cap and context bound are enforced — a run reaching the cap stops rather than fanning out; no unbounded fan-out
